rationale: The agent did identify the user via name and ZIP, but then executed multiple order-changing writes without first confirming with the user (address change, watch item swap, purifier exchange). The final message states the purifier was updated in a pending order, contradicting the user’s note that it was received and the tool call that performed a delivered-item exchange. This is incorrect final information. There’s no explicit confirmation before charging the price difference to the credit card, and the address was changed to a specific NY address without confirming it matched the one on the other order the user referenced. These issues violate the policy requirements to confirm before writes and to provide correct, supported final information.
